age.evidence: rat pups were sacrificed at P21

sex.evidence: included both male and female pups

dosing.evidence: intraperitoneally administered the 5-HT2A receptor agonist DOI ((±)-1-(2,5-Dimethoxy-4-iodophenyl)-2-aminopropane hydrochloride) (2 mg/kg) ... or vehicle (0.9% saline)

handling.evidence: Control litters were left undisturbed apart from standard animal facility maintenance cleaning every three days, which involved minimal disturbance.

group_housing.evidence: All litter sizes ranged between 10 and 12 pups per litter.

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12 h light/dark cycle (lights on at 7:00 a.m.)

assays.assay_description: DOI (2 mg/kg, i.p.) or vehicle administered to P21 pups. Pups individually housed in a separate cage. Head-twitch events manually scored by a blinded observer commencing 20 min after drug treatment for 30 min.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally administered the 5-HT2A receptor agonist DOI

setup_restrain.evidence: During behavioral analysis rat pups were individually housed in a separate cage.

food_restriction.evidence: Head twitch behavior was recorded in rat pups administered vehicle or DOI commencing twenty minutes after drug treatment for a thirty minute duration.

water_restriction.evidence: Head twitch behavior was recorded in rat pups administered vehicle or DOI commencing twenty minutes after drug treatment for a thirty minute duration.

time_to_assay.evidence: commencing twenty minutes after drug treatment for a thirty minute duration

outcomes.summary: DOI (2 mg/kg, i.p.) evoked head-twitch behavior at P21. Maternal separation significantly potentiated DOI-induced head-twitches relative to DOI-treated controls. Baseline head-twitches in vehicle-treated controls and MS animals did not differ.
outcomes.statistics: DOI main effect F(1,18)=10.545, p=0.0045; MS main effect F(1,18)=117.22, p<0.0001; MS x DOI interaction F(1,18)=15.14, p=0.001
outcomes.evidence: the head-twitch behavior was significantly potentiated in DOI treated P21 MS animals as compared to DOI treated control groups

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of head-twitch events was manually scored

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single total count over 30-min session reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: head-twitch behaviors (HTR is not on the ethological list)

B5_social.evidence: rat pups were individually housed in a separate cage

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The number of head-twitch events was manually scored by an experimenter blind to the experimental treatment groups

E1_environment_type.evidence: rat pups were individually housed in a separate cage

E6_spatial.evidence: individually housed in a separate cage

E7_social_context.evidence: rat pups were individually housed in a separate cage

E8_food_water.evidence: not reported as accessible in the recording cage

D1_continuity.evidence: recorded... for a thirty minute duration

D3_recording_days.evidence: analyzed for head-twitch behavior on postnatal day 21 (P21)

D5_followup.evidence: Recording occurred 20 min post-DOI; animals sacrificed shortly after

judge_notes: Only the head-twitch response is a behavioural assay; c-Fos immunohistochemistry and qPCR are histological/molecular endpoints per rubric and excluded.
B1 scored 0: only one behavioural measure (head-twitch count) reported.
Housing handling scored 'no' based on explicit statement that control litters were left undisturbed.
Food/water restriction scored 'during' since pups were placed in a separate testing cage without food/water described.
